ai.text: This resolution would impeach President Donald Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors. It includes one article of impeachment, which accuses him of abusing presidential power. The article says he allowed U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to operate in ways that violate the First, Fourth, and Fifth Amendments to the U.S. Constitution. It also says this undermined oversight by the courts.

summary.label: Congressional Research Service, Introduced in House
summary.text:
This resolution impeaches President Donald Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors.
Specifically, the resolution sets forth one article of impeachment concerning abuse of presidential powers by allowing U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to operate in violation of the First, Fourth, and Fifth Amendments to the U.S. Constitution while undermining judicial oversight.
